title: Consolidate duplicate onboarding test coverage instead of maintaining parallel suites

testWidgets('starts at profileCreation: name field + mode pills visible', (

why: onboarding_screen_test.dart's testWidgets + childAwareText tests are near-line-for-line duplicates of onboarding_bulk_l1_test.dart's 'profileCreation phase' and 'childAwareText helper' groups (same button text, same disabled-state check, same ACTIVE-badge tap, same substitution cases) — it reads like the pre-L1 file the L1 rewrite was meant to replace but never deleted. learning_process_wizard_service_test.dart runs the same scenario (e.g. noReview creates one לימוד stage) through two differently-named group blocks repeatedly, several pairs marked '(F2 variant)' — roughly half of its 31 tests are redundant with the other half. Every future behavior change to these services must be updated in 2 places or the suites silently diverge.
recommendation: Delete onboarding_screen_test.dart (fully superseded) or trim it to whatever the L1 suite doesn't cover. In learning_process_wizard_service_test.dart, merge each '(F2 variant)'/second-group pair into the first, keeping the more specific assertions from each.
acceptance_criteria: Total test count in the 2 files drops by the number of confirmed-duplicate cases with no coverage regression on the 2 lib files under test
